faucet.note: spout runs along X; flip to -X if the spout points at the wall

tissue_holder.note: insertion point on its back face, body runs towards +Y

muslim_shower.note: family is drawn lying down, 17-19 ft from its insertion point: placed as drawn, flagged in the report

soap_dispenser.note: family is drawn lying down: placed as drawn, flagged in the report

exhaust.note: 3in thin along X: a wall unit facing X. -X assumes its insertion point is on its back face (it is: X -3 to 0). Flip to +X if it faces the wall.

drawings.note: Drawing set AR-141 to AR-148. wall_tile_top null = tiles up to the ceiling. Any other DrawingRules value (label texts, text sizes) can be set here too.
